title: OXP Manifest
description: The oxp.json file at the root of every OXP extension bundle. Spec version 1.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor autocomplete. Ignored by the OXP CLI.

specVersion.description: OXP spec version this manifest conforms to. Must be '1'.

kind.description: Bundle kind (Phase A.10 / WASM pivot). Controls which artifacts may ship inside the bundle. If omitted, the host derives it from the legacy fields: ui.components == 'oxp-ui-v1' → 'ui-v1'; main.wasm with no main.ui → 'component-v1'; both → 'hybrid-v1'.

id.description: Globally unique extension id: '@<publisher>/<slug>'. Lowercase, kebab-case slug.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in IDE chrome and the registry.

description.description: One-sentence summary. Plain text. Shown in search results.

publisher.description: Publisher handle. Must match the publisher segment of `id` and resolve to a verified publisher on oxp.sh.

provenance.description: Optional reproducible-build provenance hints (Phase B.4). Lets the registry / consumers re-build the bundle from source and compare hashes. The fields are advisory; cryptographic attestation goes in the publish-time `attestation` multipart field (Phase B.5).

commit.description: Source commit SHA the bundle was built from.

buildCommand.description: Single shell command that reproduces the bundle from a clean checkout of `commit` (e.g. 'pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build && oxp pack').

sourceUrl.description: Source-tree URL pinned to the build commit (e.g. https://github.com/org/repo/tree/<sha>).

scripts.description: Author-defined build hooks. `oxp pack` runs `scripts.build` (when set) before walking the bundle directory; `oxp publish` runs `scripts.prepublish` after a successful pack and before upload. Each value is a single shell command executed via `sh -c` with the project root as cwd. Skip with `--no-build` / `--no-prepublish`.

build.description: Shell command that produces the bundle artefacts (compiles WASM, copies assets, etc.). Must place all output under paths declared in the manifest before exiting.

prepublish.description: Shell command run after pack and before upload. Useful for running tests or attestation tooling against the freshly-built bundle.

icon.description: Path within the bundle to a square SVG (preferred) or PNG ≥128px.

main.description: Entry points within the bundle. At least one of `ui` or `wasm` is required.

ui.description: Path to the UI entry within the bundle. `.html` for HTML extensions, or `.json` when `ui.components` is `oxp-ui-v1` (a static component tree).

wasm.description: Path to the logic Wasm component (WASI Component Model, Preview 2).

activationEvents.description: When the host should activate this extension. 'onStartup' is discouraged and warned at publish.

permissions.description: Capabilities this extension requests. Shown to the user at install time. Sensitive capabilities additionally prompt at first use.

contributes.description: Static contributions to the host UI. Each value is a path to a contributions JSON file in the bundle.

components.description: Render mode. 'oxp-ui-only' is a promise to author with @oxprotocol/ui factories (V0). 'oxp-ui-v1' opts into the frozen V1 component tree (Box/Stack/Text/Button/VirtualList/CodeBlock) and unlocks the Piye native renderer. 'escape-hatch' allows raw HTML in webview hosts only.

preferredSurface.description: Default surface to mount the UI on.

hosts.description: Host compatibility matrix. Hosts not listed are assumed compatible at L0 (sideload).

telemetry.description: Optional, opt-in telemetry endpoint. Users may revoke per-extension at any time.

integrity.description: Set by `oxp publish`. Do not author by hand.

wit.description: WIT contract pin (Phase A.11). Required for bundles that ship a Wasm component; optional for declarative-only `oxp-ui-v1` bundles. The registry recomputes the canonical sha256 of the bundled `wit/world.wit` at publish time and rejects mismatches; hosts refuse to instantiate components pinned to a package@version they do not ship.

package.description: The WIT package the component targets. v1 ships exactly one supported value.

version.description: Pinned package version. v1 ships exactly one supported value.

sha256.description: Hex sha256 over the canonical form of the bundled WIT world (see @oxprotocol/wit canonicalWorldSha256).

limits.description: Per-call resource limits applied by the host runtime (Phase A.12 / A.13). The host enforces a wall-clock cap on every host→component call (timeMsPerCall). The maxMemoryMb hint is enforced by wasmtime-backed hosts; jco-backed hosts log a warning when set above the default.

timeMsPerCall.description: Maximum wall-clock duration of a single host→component call in milliseconds. Default 100, max 5000.

maxMemoryMb.description: Maximum linear memory the component may grow to, in MiB. Default 64, max 256.

id.description: Capability identifier. See spec/v1/permissions.md for the full list.

scope.description: Glob list scoping the capability. Allowed context vars: ${workspace}, ${extdata}, ${tmp}. URL-pattern globs for net.fetch.

rationale.description: Plain-text reason shown to the user at the consent prompt. Required.

sensitivity.description: Author-declared. Registry will override to 'sensitive' for fs.delete, fs.write outside ${extdata}, terminal.shell, secrets.*, net.fetch with wildcard host, process.kill.

tier.description: Highest integration tier this extension targets on this host. L0 sideload always works; L1 surfaces in native discovery; L2 uses the host's native renderer.

reason.description: If `compatible` is false, the human-readable reason.
